sources.title: GGUF Model Discovery - Browse & Download AI Models
sources.snippet: Discover and download GGUF format AI models. Browse and direct download thousands of quantized AI models with detailed information, download counts, and direct links.

sources.title: GGUF-Models (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF is a modern file format for storing models optimized for efficient inference, particularly on consumer-grade hardware. This makes it easier for researchers, developers, and hobbyists to experiment with and deploy large language models.

sources.title: GitHub - IBM/gguf: IBM GGUF-encoded AI models and conversion scripts
sources.snippet: This repository provides an automated CI/CD process to convert, test and deploy IBM Granite models, in safetensor format, from the ibm-granite organization to IBM GGUF versions (with various supported quantizations) within model repositories respectively named with the -GGUF extension. These GGUF model repositories are also included to the Granite Quantized Model collection for convenience.

sources.title: Where to Download GGUF Models - Best Sources & Direct Links (2025)
sources.snippet: Download GGUF models from HuggingFace, TheBloke, bartowski. Direct links to Mistral 7B, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek, Phi-3 — Q4_K_M and Q5_K_M quantized for local AI.
